_comment: Data-driven fallback main menu / title screen (docs/HudSystem.md §11a). Loaded by UI::loadGameScreenInto(ui,"mainmenu",...) into mainmenu:* screens; replaces ImGui renderMainMenu. Used by games WITHOUT a sceneType:"menu" start scene (games that DO have one render that menu scene instead). {{title}} resolves via MenuActions.onResolveVariable; buttons: start_game / open_settings / quit_game.
